title: Recorded Offences for Smoking in Common Corridors and Void Decks of HDB Blocks and of High-rise Littering of Cigarette Butts and Ash
what_it_is: Recorded Offences for Smoking in Common Corridors and Void Decks of HDB Blocks and of High-rise Littering of Cigarette Butts and Ash

sections.label: Smoking tickets in HDB estates
sections.summary: NEA issued over 11,000 tickets for smoking along HDB common corridors and void decks in three years, about 15% of all smoking tickets.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources)
sentences.text: Over the past three years, the National Environment Agency (NEA) issued more than 11,000 tickets for smoking along common corridors and void decks of Housing and Development Board (HDB) estates.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources)
sentences.text: This makes up about 15% of the total number of tickets issued for smoking in prohibited places during that period.

sections.label: Enforcement against high-rise cigarette littering
sections.summary: NEA took over 2,200 enforcement actions against high-rise littering involving cigarette litter from HDB flats, about 76% of such actions.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources)
sentences.text: Over the same period, NEA took more than 2,200 enforcement actions against high-rise littering from HDB flats involving cigarette litter.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources)
sentences.text: This makes up about 76% of the total enforcement actions taken for high-rise littering during that period.

sections.label: Thermal cameras in smoking-prohibited areas
sections.summary: NEA deploys thermal cameras in public residential areas with persistent smoking feedback, capturing images with date and time for investigations.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: As the Member knows, we cannot constantly monitor all the 32,000-odd smoking-prohibited places or respond immediately to every feedback, especially given the fleeting nature of the act.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: So, to reinforce the no-smoking regulations, NEA has started deploying thermal cameras in public residential areas, particularly the common corridors, the lift lobbies, the stairwells, where there is persistent feedback on smoking issues.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: The cameras are able to capture images of the smoking infringement as well as the date and time, and this allows NEA to follow up with investigations.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: As regard the second question, I am afraid I do not have any updates on this.

sections.label: Thermal camera service outsourced
sections.summary: The thermal camera service is outsourced to a third party.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: With regard to thermal cameras, we outsource it to a third party to provide this service.
